# unh_marine_navigation

- **Layer**: core
- **Packages**: `marine_nav_behavior_tree`, `marine_nav_behaviors`, `marine_nav_bt_task_navigator`, `marine_nav_crabbing_path_follower`, `marine_nav_interfaces`, `marine_nav_tasks`, `marine_nav_utilities`

## Key Dependencies
- nav2_behaviors, nav2_core, pluginlib, rclcpp, rclcpp_lifecycle, control_toolbox, visualization_msgs, yaml_cpp_vendor, geometry_msgs, nav_msgs

## Description
